title: SVARA Research Recording Metadata Schema
description: Metadata manifest schema for CompMusic, Saraga, and curated Hindustani/Carnatic Raga research splits.

recording_id.description: Immutable source recording identifier (never split clips of the same recording_id across train/val/test).

clip_id.description: Optional excerpt identifier linked back to recording_id.

raga_label.description: Canonical Raga identifier matching server/data/ragas.json where applicable.

performer_id.description: Optional performer/artist ID used to enforce performer-disjoint evaluation splits.

tonic_hz.description: Ground-truth annotated tonic (Sa) frequency in Hz, if provided by source dataset.

licensing_conditions.description: Research license terms (e.g., CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 / Dunya non-commercial academic use).
